title: mymind feature cards
description: A big white sheet with rounded top corners floating on a tangerine-to-blush wash: tangerine spaced capitals and a two-line serif headline, then a bento of soft pastel cards (beige, mist blue, sage, rose, peach, grey) in alternating narrow/wide rows and full-width photo cards, each with a picture area above a large grotesk title and a slate paragraph. Pictures ease up in scale on hover.
notes: card tones are mixes of tokens (secondary, muted, highlight, chart-2, primary, muted-foreground), so they re-theme
a full-width card can be a dark photo card (forces the theme's dark tokens inside it)
the 'after' slot renders inside the sheet under the cards (the page puts mymind-feature-tabs there)
